summary: Pass D: folds Weather Voice Persona management into the Weather Configuration workflow, presents alert-beep interval in minutes, makes Alert FX Cart searchable, splits routine vs. Advanced fieldsets, adds explicit NWS discovery, and moves the Weather Alert Beep's qualifying-event list out of a hard-coded weather_ingest constant into WeatherConfig.alert_sound_trigger_events (same legacy defaults/matching, independent of spoken WxAlert/AMBER paths). One migration; no upgrade behavior change.
